info.title: Overviu API
info.description: Read your listings and availability, and create and manage bookings, from your own systems. Authenticate with an API token from **Settings → API tokens** in Overviu, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Endpoints under `/v1/public/{teamSlug}` need no token: they serve what your booking site shows. Guides and conventions: https://docs.overviu.app/api-reference/introduction

tags.name: Account
tags.description: The team an API token belongs to.

tags.name: Bookings
tags.description: Create, read, change and cancel the team's bookings.

tags.name: Public
tags.description: What a booking site shows, with no token.

get.description:
Returns the team the API token belongs to and the token's name, abilities and when it was last used. Call it to
check that a token works.
get.summary: Get the current team and token

get.description:
Returns all of the team's listings (draft, active and archived; standalone listings, buildings and unit types),
sorted by title, with their photos. Paginated with `page` and `per_page` (default 20).

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

get.description: Returns one of the team's listings with its photos. A listing of another team returns 404.

Checks whether the listing can be booked from `check_in` to `check_out` (`Y-m-d`, check-out after check-in) for
`guests` people, and returns the price breakdown in cents. Pass `coupon_code` to apply a coupon; a coupon that
doesn't apply returns 422 with the reason.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

next_cursor.description: The "cursor" that points to the next set of items.

prev_cursor.description: The "cursor" that points to the previous set of items.

post.description:
Creates a booking with source `api` and status `pending`, priced like the booking site, and returns it with
status 201. The guest is matched to an existing guest of the team with the same email, or created. Dates that
aren't available return 422 with the reason in `errors.availability`; a coupon that doesn't apply returns 422
in `errors.coupon_code`.

get.description: Returns one of the team's bookings with its listing, guest and unit. A booking of another team returns 404.

put.description:
Changes the dates, number of guests, guest details, notes or special requests of one of the team's bookings.
Send only what changes. New dates are checked and priced again; unavailable dates return 422 in
`errors.availability`, and a booking that can no longer be changed (e.g. cancelled or completed) returns 422.

post.description:
Cancels one of the team's bookings, with an optional `reason`. Its dates are freed, payments scheduled for later
won't be taken, open invoices are voided and a security deposit held is returned. Payments already made for the
stay aren't refunded automatically: refund them from the booking in Overviu. A booking that can't be cancelled
returns 422.

get.description:
Returns the team's guests sorted by name. Search by name or email with `search`. Cursor-paginated: follow
`links.next`; `per_page` defaults to 20.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

next_cursor.description: The "cursor" that points to the next set of items.

prev_cursor.description: The "cursor" that points to the previous set of items.

get.description: Returns one of the team's guests. A guest of another team returns 404.

Returns the listings a team shows on its booking site (active, listed on the site), with photos and, for
buildings, their bookable unit types. No token needed. Paginated with `page` and `per_page` (default 20).

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

get.description: Returns one listing as the booking site shows it, by the team's slug and the listing's slug. No token needed.

Returns each day from `start_date` to `end_date` (`Y-m-d`) with its price, rules and how many units are left.
No token needed.

Checks whether a booking-site listing can be booked for the dates and guests, and returns the price breakdown in
cents, as the booking site would. No token needed. Accepts a `coupon_code`.
get.summary: Check availability and price on the booking site

http.description: An API token from **Settings → API tokens** in Overviu, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
